When God speaks quietly

A short read beside young Samuel—pairs with when the house gets quiet and the full Samuel hears God story.

Read-aloud

Young Samuel did not know the voice at first. Eli helped him understand. When God called his name, Samuel learned a gentle answer we can still use—at the table, at bedtime, in an ordinary quiet minute.

And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. 1 Samuel 3:10 (KJV)

God still speaks through His Word. We do not have to be loud or perfect—just willing to listen for a moment.

Gentle question

What is one quiet minute today when we could open the Bible and listen together?

Short prayer together

Speak, LORD; for we are listening. Help us hear You in Your Word. Amen.

Coloring idea

Lamp still burning, young Samuel listening in the Lord’s house. Color & Tell → Boy Samuel. Or Verse Image → Quiet porch (T17).
